goal: Determine the smallest defensible redesign of the Invoke and Task Session lifecycle that stops repeated plan refreshes while preserving fail-closed evidence admission, one-SWU execution, and public-private authority boundaries.
context: Recent telemetry and DS-SFOL and BTE evidence show a recurring cycle: planning appears complete, Task Session discovers missing or stale implementation material, closeout routes back through Refresh, and exact joined receipts become stale again. This research must separate local run validity from lifecycle progress, resolve implementation-material ownership, and examine external primary-source precedents for durable workflows, immutable planning, optimistic concurrency, versioning, and idempotent materialization. The outputs are private research input for a later sanitized Spellcraft change; no Invoke or Task Session mutation is authorized.
anti_bias_global: simplify lifecycle progress without weakening evidence admission

agents.angle: Empirical internal causal archaeology over current Invoke and Task Session contracts, central and temporary telemetry, and DS-SFOL and BTE receipts; derive sanitized generic public invariants from private evidence, explicitly verify that no private paths, vocabulary, or prose enter proposed canonical Arcanum changes, treat reproducible local transition failures as primary, and resist importing generic solutions. Ashby runs empirical causal reconstruction on local contracts and receipts, Simon runs historical-comparative precedent over external primary-source workflow systems on the composite methodology + source-corpus axis; a local-overfitting bias in Ashby would be exposed by Simon, while a solution-transplant bias in Simon would be exposed by Ashby.
agents.initial_prompt: Perform a read-only internal causal audit of Invoke lifecycle churn. Inspect the current canonical arcanum/spells/invoke README, define, design, plan, and refresh contracts; arcanum/arcana/task-session SKILL and README; implementation-material schemas and validators; the current workflow-reflect report; central and temporary telemetry; DS-SFOL Task Session evidence; BTE refresh evidence; and relevant Inventory leads. Build a causal transition graph, an artifact-owner table, concrete cycle witnesses, and an earliest-detection analysis. Derive public-safe generic invariants from the private evidence, explicitly separating private evidence from any proposed public wording. Identify the smallest candidate fixes and what each would fail to solve. Do not edit files. Return evidence-backed prose with precise repository citations suitable for verbatim inclusion under an Agent section in research.md.

agents.angle: Comparative primary-source research into durable workflow execution, event histories, immutable plan snapshots, optimistic concurrency, versioning, retry and idempotence, and materialization ownership; seek transferable mechanisms without assuming external systems share Arcanum's authority model. Ashby runs empirical causal reconstruction on local contracts and receipts, Simon runs historical-comparative precedent over external primary-source workflow systems on the composite methodology + source-corpus axis; a local-overfitting bias in Ashby would be exposed by Simon, while a solution-transplant bias in Simon would be exposed by Ashby.
agents.initial_prompt: Perform read-only external research using primary or official sources only. Compare mechanisms from durable workflow systems and reproducible build or deployment systems that prevent plan-execution-refresh churn: immutable workflow or plan snapshots, event histories, activity retry and idempotence, signals or explicit transition events, optimistic concurrency or compare-and-swap, workflow versioning, and clear materialization ownership. Suitable sources include official Temporal or Cadence semantics, official cloud durable-workflow documentation, authoritative event-sourcing material, and official Bazel or Nix material where directly relevant. Cite direct sources and dates. Translate findings into patterns and anti-patterns applicable to Invoke and Task Session without transplanting an external architecture wholesale. Do not edit files. Return evidence-backed prose with links suitable for verbatim inclusion under an Agent section in research.md.

groups.anti_bias: force a minimal causal model and kill options that do not remove a demonstrated cycle

agents.initial_prompt: Synthesize the two explorer returns plus the recorded Inventory selection and exclusion rationale. agents.angle: Precedent-fit attack: test whether the synthesis selectively borrows external workflow language without preserving the actual guarantees or respecting Arcanum's local authority boundary. Schön runs owner/precedent verification, Popper runs executable-witness falsification on the attack-vector axis; Schön's reuse bias is exposed if owned machinery cannot produce a witness, while Popper's novelty bias is exposed by an already-owned working mechanism. Schön runs owner/precedent verification, Tetlock runs definitional-collapse analysis on the attack-vector axis; Schön's owner-match bias is exposed if the concept is only nominally similar, while Tetlock's collapse bias is exposed by a materially distinct owned contract.
